basic_details.job_title: IIITDM Jabalpur Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: PDPM Indian Institute of Information Technology Design and Manufacturing Jabalpur (IIITDM Jabalpur) has notified 1 vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow post on a contract basis for a tenure initially of one year, extendable for one more year based on satisfactory performance. Eligible applicants must possess a B.E./B.Tech or M.E./M.Tech with 1st class or equivalent in ECE or any allied branch relevant to the project. The pay is Rs. 37,000 per month + HRA. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the following eligibility criteria to apply for the Junior Research Fellow position: Essential Qualification: B.E./B.Tech or M.E./M.Tech with 1st class or equivalent in ECE or any allied branch relevant to the project. Desirable Qualification: Knowledge/experience in areas of communication and signal processing will be given preference. Additional Preference: Preference will be given to GATE/NET qualified candidates. Age Limit: Age limit is 35 years.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIITDM Jabalpur Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Visit the official application link provided by IIITDM Jabalpur. Fill out the Google form available at https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdLvYkC3GeiqlNFjpvwSAjl2NaflvIKBk-0bxs3uvu3WBkQcA/viewform before the submission deadline. Ensure all required details regarding qualifications and experience are correctly entered in the application form.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process involves a written test and/or an interview. The interview is scheduled tentatively for 6 November 2026 at 11:00 AM and will be conducted in online or offline mode. Shortlisted candidates will be notified through email. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for appearing in the written test or interview.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Junior Research Fellow post permanent or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: The position is temporary, offered initially for one year, and is extendable for one more year based on satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q2. Are there any allowances paid on top of the fellowship amount?
faq.answer: Yes, the selected candidate receives Rs. 37,000 per month plus HRA as per Institute norms.

faq.question: Q3. Who is given preference during the shortlisting process?
faq.answer: Preference is given to GATE/NET qualified candidates, as well as those with knowledge or experience in communication and signal processing.

faq.question: Q4. Where will the shortlist details and interview schedule be communicated?
faq.answer: The shortlisted candidates will be notified regarding the test or interview details through email.
